name: io.github.jasperan/oraviz-mcp
description: Visualization-first MCP server for Oracle AI Database: read-only queries, profiling, and PNG charts

ORACLE_USER.description: Dedicated Oracle reader with CREATE SESSION and object-level READ grants; never an administrator

ORACLE_DSN.description: Full EZConnect descriptor (e.g. localhost:1521/FREEPDB1); overrides host/port/service

ORACLE_MCP_MAX_ROWS.description: Hard cap on rows returned per query, 1..5000 (default: 500)

ORACLE_MCP_PREVIEW_ROWS.description: Preview rows, 1..5000, also bounded by max rows (default: 25)

ORACLE_MCP_ALLOWED_TOOLS.description: Comma-separated exact tool names; unset enables seven, empty/unknown entries reject startup

ORACLE_CALL_TIMEOUT.description: Database round-trip timeout in seconds, 1..300; cannot disable (default: 60)

ORACLE_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT.description: Transport: stdio (default), http, sse, streamable-http; every network transport requires auth

ORACLE_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER.description: Required for network transports: HTTPS JWT issuer

ORACLE_MCP_AUTH_AUDIENCE.description: Required for network transports: JWT resource audience

ORACLE_MCP_AUTH_JWKS_URL.description: Required for network transports: HTTPS JWKS endpoint (RS256)

ORACLE_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES.description: Required for network transports: space-separated scopes, e.g. oraviz:read

ORACLE_MCP_AUTH_BASE_URL.description: Optional public HTTPS base URL for OAuth discovery; omit /mcp or /sse

ORACLE_MCP_BIND_HOST.description: Host to bind for network transports (default: 127.0.0.1)

ORACLE_MCP_BIND_PORT.description: Port to bind for network transports (default: 8080)

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Executes a read-only SELECT/WITH query and returns a compact, preview-capped markdown table

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists tables and views in the current or a given schema

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Returns columns, types, nullability, and primary key membership for a table or view

tools.name: sample_table_data
tools.description: Returns a small sample of rows from a table as a compact markdown table

tools.name: get_table_details
tools.description: Returns table metadata and optimizer statistics, optionally an exact row count

tools.name: profile_table
tools.description: Profiles columns (nulls, distinct counts, min/max/avg) to decide which chart fits the data

tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Runs a read-only query and renders the result as a PNG chart (bar, line, area, scatter, pie, histogram, vector/PCA)
